title: Hospital bed: rent or buy
brief: Wendell Park's doctor wants him to have a hospital bed at home. Find out whether it is rented or bought under Medicare, get Wendell's choice where there is one, and place the order with an enrolled supplier.
rule_basis: DME order; enrolled supplier; rental needs assignment for all rental months; rent-vs-buy depends on the item.

flags.rule_known: rent-vs-buy rule for the bed known
flags.supplier_ok: supplier enrolled and accepting assignment for all rental months
flags.bed_ordered: bed ordered on the chosen basis

actions.desc: Ask the insurer whether the bed is rented or bought
actions.reply: For this bed Medicare allows renting or buying. The patient pays 20% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible.
actions.narration: I asked the insurer: for this bed Wendell can rent or buy, and he pays 20% after the Part B deductible.

actions.desc: Ask the insurer about Summit Home Care Equipment
actions.reply: Summit Home Care Equipment is enrolled and accepts assignment for all rental months.
actions.narration: I confirmed Summit Home Care Equipment is enrolled and accepts assignment for all rental months.

actions.desc: Ask the doctor's office for the bed order
actions.narration: I asked Dr. Fischer's office and they wrote the hospital bed order for home use.

actions.desc: Ask Wendell whether to rent or buy
actions.reply: I would like to rent it.
actions.narration: I asked Wendell and he chose to rent the bed.
I told Wendell he pays 20% after the deductible.

actions.desc: Give the supplier Wendell's Medicare number
actions.narration: I gave Summit Wendell's Medicare number.

actions.reply: Rental order placed. Delivery next week.
actions.narration: I placed the bed rental order with Summit Home Care Equipment.

financial_hardship_note.text: Patient is on a fixed income.
